info.title: DAO Budget Simulator API
info.description: Read API for an indexed DAO deployment. Use the chain ID and deployment name from your running environment. Example `qa07-e2e` is the isolated QA07 demo scope. No authentication is required. Unknown/repeated query keys are rejected. API routes accept GET and CORS preflight OPTIONS; other methods receive 405. Responses use canonical decimal strings for on-chain quantities (timestamps are seconds since Unix epoch), not JavaScript numbers. Cursor tokens are signed and tied to the snapshot and request, with a default lifetime of 900 seconds (configurable 60–86400).

get.description: Returns treasury totals, proposal counts, verified governance configuration and up to five recent BUD transfers. When omitted, the block/hash pair selects the current publication or the cursor's snapshot.

503.description: Database unavailable, or the deployment has no trustworthy publication (including recovery or rebuild). This is a health envelope.

ChainId.name: chainId
ChainId.description: Positive canonical decimal uint256. Choose the chain of the indexed deployment. The server also checks the exact upper bound 2^256-1.

DeploymentId.name: deploymentId
DeploymentId.description: Exact deployment name (not the internal database ID). No surrounding whitespace or control characters U+0000–U+001F. The server measures the 128-character cap in UTF-16 code units.

Block.name: asOfBlock
Block.description: Snapshot block as canonical decimal uint256. Required when asOfBlockHash is supplied. The server also checks the exact upper bound 2^256-1.

BlockHash.name: asOfBlockHash
BlockHash.description: Canonical hash at asOfBlock. Required when asOfBlock is supplied.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size in canonical decimal notation.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Use nextCursor as-is. Keep endpoint, chain, deployment, filters, limit and any explicit snapshot pin unchanged.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Canonical decimal Governor proposal ID (uint256, no leading zeros). Copy a proposalId from the list. The server also checks the exact upper bound 2^256-1.

ProposalId.name: proposalId
ProposalId.description: Exact canonical decimal proposal ID (uint256). A valid ID without matches returns an empty page. The server also checks the exact upper bound 2^256-1.

State.name: state
State.description: Case-sensitive proposal state at the snapshot.

OriginDenied.description: Origin header is outside the configured CORS allowlist, when the list is enabled. Code INVALID_ARGUMENT.

DeploymentNotFound.description: DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND: the chain/deployment pair is not registered.

DataNotReady.description: DATA_NOT_READY: publication is absent, recovering, requires rebuild, has inconsistent data or metadata, or requested H exceeds publication. PostgreSQL read failure can also cause this response.

error.message: Dịch vụ dữ liệu hiện không khả dụng.

DecimalUint.description: Unsigned integer serialized as canonical decimal text. Amounts and vote weights are in token base units. Block heights, log indices and Governor timestamps also use decimal strings.

Cursor.description: Opaque signed cursor returned as pagination.nextCursor. Do not construct or edit it.

description.description: Exact UTF-8 text used to compute descriptionHash and proposalId.
